reviews.text: ★This hospital doesn't even deserve one star. It's notorious in the neighborhood for missing serious illnesses. It's fine for vaccinations and rabies shots, though.

My 10-year-old dog, who was just like my own, had collapsed and I was immersed in sadness, not knowing what to do. However, the clinic director's appropriate treatment and kind attitude encouraged me, and I was able to take it in a positive way, and now my dog ​​is doing very well. I am truly grateful. Thank you very much.

I'm always grateful for your help with vet appointments and grooming.
Thank you so much for your flexible response each time.
I hope to continue coming here with peace of mind.
You're a very trustworthy company, so I'd definitely recommend you to others.

Despite it being my first time and a sudden call, they kindly saw my child just before closing time.

I panicked when my child suddenly started coughing, but thanks to them, he has been healthy ever since.

I am extremely grateful for their quick and accurate diagnosis.

Since moving to Tokyo, I've been using this nearby hospital.
I've had my pet vaccinated, groomed, and recently had it checked for a hernia, and every response was polite and it was clear that the director and nurses really care about animals.
They don't push expensive treatments that are unnecessarily expensive, and make suggestions based on each pet's health condition.
I've been to several veterinary hospitals, but this is one I want to keep going to.

I've been taking my dog ​​there for checkups, vaccinations, and pet boarding for about three years now.☺️ The doctor is kind and provides accurate and necessary examinations and treatments; it's a very conscientious hospital. They don't suggest unnecessary tests, so I feel very at ease leaving my dog ​​there. It's nice to see that the doctor and nurses all love animals.🐶 The hospital is spacious and clean, and if you make a reservation, the waiting time is short. It's a wonderful hospital.✨

This was my first time getting my dog ​​groomed! It seems to be located next to a veterinary clinic, and the groomers were very kind. The director was always there, treating my dog ​​with kindness, so I felt at ease leaving him in my care! At the pet shampoo places I've been to up until now, there was always a lot of pressure to add extras, but this place only offers the basic shampoo or cut course, so I didn't get pushed for options like herbal packs or carbonated spring baths, and I paid the standard price!

Their technique was also excellent, and they made my dog ​​look so cute that people walking by on the way home would smile and laugh when they saw him!

I'd like to continue using their services from now on!
